trend_risk.title: Trend & Technical Risk
trend_risk.methodology: Compares current price to 250-day simple moving average (long-term regime), 20-day rate of change (ROC20 momentum), and distance to 3.0x ATR14 trailing volatility stop.
trend_risk.explanation: The stock is trading 9.0% above its 250-day moving average. Technical signal is EXIT with a 2.6% buffer before triggering trailing stop rules.
